_comment: Master catalogue of all intended E2E acceptance scenarios. This is the fixed denominator for the e2e coverage badge. Add an entry here whenever a new feature needs an E2E test — even before the test is written. The badge script counts entries where 'implemented' is true AND the matching spec title passes in CI.

scenarios.description: App loads without JS errors
POST /api/sessions returns valid UUID
First GameStateUpdate arrives within 15 s
Tick counter increments (clock advancing at ≥1×)
Pause halts tick stream; resume restarts it
DecommitGenerator → committed=false in next store update
CommitGenerator → committed=true after decommit baseline
Pill badges (load, health, price, clock) non-empty after boot
Speed change via 10× button reflected in store
Run Dispatch button opens DispatchPanel
Real-time tab renders at least one generator row
Day-ahead tab renders UC schedule grid
Plan Day button opens PlanningPanel
N-1 tab shows violations table or empty state
POST /powerflow/run returns converged boolean
POST /contingencies/trigger responds 200 or 422
Timeline strip and now-marker visible after bootstrap
Clicking network element opens InspectorPanel
Alert toast appears when violation is triggered
Event card overlay appears and accept updates game state
